summary: P1-HOTSPOTS Module Testing Complete - All backend APIs and frontend UI working correctly. 20/20 API tests PASS. Frontend displays 'Hotspots BIONIC' button, control panel with 3 sections (Hotspots, Zones, Corridors), and renders hotspot contours on the map (64 paths visible).
passed_tests: GET /api/v1/bionic/map/status returns module info (P1-HOTSPOTS v1.0.0, active)
GET /api/v1/bionic/map/status lists all 3 endpoints correctly
GET /api/v1/bionic/map/status shows visual specs (fill_opacity=0, chaikin smoothing)
POST /api/v1/bionic/map/hotspots returns 200 with success=true
POST /api/v1/bionic/map/hotspots returns valid GeoJSON Polygon geometry
POST /api/v1/bionic/map/hotspots hotspots have transparent fill (fill_opacity=0)
POST /api/v1/bionic/map/hotspots hotspots have proper metadata
POST /api/v1/bionic/map/zones returns 200 with success=true
POST /api/v1/bionic/map/zones returns valid GeoJSON Polygon geometry
POST /api/v1/bionic/map/zones zones have behavior_context
POST /api/v1/bionic/map/corridors returns 200 with success=true
POST /api/v1/bionic/map/corridors returns valid GeoJSON LineString geometry
POST /api/v1/bionic/map/corridors corridors have movement_context
All 10 hotspot types supported (activity_peak, feeding_zone, rut_zone, etc.)
All 7 zone types supported (feeding, bedding, rut_arena, etc.)
Frontend: 'Hotspots BIONIC' button visible in map toolbar
Frontend: Control panel 'Overlays BIONIC' opens on button click
Frontend: Panel has 3 sections (Hotspots 3/10, Zones 3/7, Corridors 3/4)
Frontend: Toggle switches work for individual layer activation
Frontend: Hotspot contours render on map (64 paths visible after enabling)
critical_code_review_comments: Services architecture follows clean separation: hotspot_service.py, zone_service.py, corridor_service.py
ContourGenerator uses proper algorithms: Marching Squares + Douglas-Peucker + Chaikin for natural shapes
All responses include proper GeoJSON format with Polygon/LineString geometries
Style specs enforced: fill_opacity=0 (transparent centers), stroke_width 1-2px
Frontend HotspotOverlay.jsx correctly fetches data from APIs and renders via react-leaflet GeoJSON
Frontend HotspotControlPanel.jsx provides full UI for layer control with group activation
seed_data_creation: None required - hotspots are generated dynamically from P0-STABLE scores
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1-HOTSPOTS module fully verified. Key endpoints: GET /api/v1/bionic/map/status, POST /api/v1/bionic/map/hotspots, POST /api/v1/bionic/map/zones, POST /api/v1/bionic/map/corridors. All return valid GeoJSON with contours (Polygon for hotspots/zones, LineString for corridors). Frontend has 'Hotspots BIONIC' button in map toolbar that opens control panel. Hotspots toggle shows 64 paths on map when enabled. All styles conform to BIONIC V5 specs (transparent centers, thin contours, natural shapes).
